app.name: Smart Home
app.tagline: Control every room, one tap away

onboarding.title: Welcome to Smart Home
onboarding.blurb: Manage lighting, climate, curtains and security for every room from a single app.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to control your smart home.
login.terms: By continuing, you agree to let this app manage your smart home devices.

home.noRoomsHint: Add your first room to start organizing devices.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the language of the app.

logoutDialog.stillPending_other: {{count}} changes still couldn't be sent. Check the connection and try again, or discard them.

category.emptyHint: Tap the + button to add a device to this category.

room.irHubHint: IR Hub · tap to add a function
room.removeDescription_one: This also removes {{count}} linked device. This can't be undone.
room.removeDescription_other: This also removes {{count}} linked devices. This can't be undone.

addRoom.title: Add a room
addRoom.description: Give your room a name and pick an icon.

transport.title: Connection method
transport.autoDesc: RS485 if wired, otherwise MQTT or Bluetooth by signal.
transport.mqttDesc: Always over the network. Fails if the hub is offline.
transport.bleDesc: Always over BLE. Fails if out of range.
transport.rs485Desc: Always over the assigned COM port. Fails if unplugged.
transport.noPorts: No COM ports found. Plug in the RS485 adapter, then rescan.

hubLive.measuredInRoom: Measured at the hub in this room

addDevice.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

hubIr.name: IR Hub
hubIr.desc: Controls ACs and other appliances via infrared — AC codes or a learning remote.

relay8.name: 8-channel relay module
relay8.desc: 8 independent on/off switches — lights, pumps, gates, or any wired load.

ac.title: Air conditioner
ac.desc: Control an external AC via IR — pick brand and code, full control.

remote.title: Learning remote
remote.desc: Any other device (TV, fan, soundbar…) — learn buttons from its original remote.

rgb.title: RGB light
rgb.desc: Native color light built into this hub — modes, brightness, color.

temp.title: Temperature control
temp.desc: Native heating/cooling dial on this hub (not an external AC).

alarm.title: Alarm
alarm.desc: Built-in alarm on this hub — set a time and repeat days.

addDevice.webPairingBody: Adding a new hub or relay module needs Bluetooth, which a browser page can't use here. Pair it in the Android or desktop app — afterwards you can control it from this page too.

pairing.wifiRejected: The device couldn't connect to that Wi-Fi network.
pairing.offlineAfterRestart: The device didn't come online after restarting. Check that this Wi-Fi network can reach the server, then try again.
pairing.saveFailed: Couldn't save the device. Try again.
pairing.scanningHint: Make sure your {{product}} is powered on and in pairing mode.
pairing.sendWifi: Send your Wi-Fi details over Bluetooth
pairing.checkingWifiHint: The device is trying to join your Wi-Fi network. This can take up to 20 seconds.
pairing.claimingHint: This can take up to 20 seconds while the device joins Wi-Fi and MQTT.

errors.bleNotFound: Device {{id}} not found over Bluetooth (out of range?)
errors.noComPort: No COM port assigned to this device yet — set one in the hub's settings.
errors.notInBrowser: This connection method needs the app: a browser can only reach the device through the server.
